decisions.reason: As the flagship transactional email service in a growing cloud messaging market, it likely meets aspirations and remains central to the firm's strategic direction.

Email-to-fax conversion still serves regulated customers who rely on fax, and it costs little to run on existing infrastructure, but declining fax use raises the risk that a shortfall triggers problemistic search.
This low-cost feature strengthens the established fax delivery business, and available slack lets the firm carry it despite the gradual decline of fax.
Rising ransomware and phishing threats make sandbox protection a growing, aspiration-meeting part of the security portfolio.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a cheap, standard part of the secure messaging offer, so there is no performance trigger to drop it, though it could be folded into a broader security bundle.
